note: PLACEHOLDER: the ring the claw tip reaches with the elbow taped (needs.md A10d). scripts/ring_calibrate.py fits centre_cm, radius_cm, scale and offset_deg from 5 points (base angle, tip position in sheet cm) and sets placeholder false. slots_deg (base angles on the ring) are set by hand once the base range is re-measured. camera_clear is set by hand (base 90, shoulder 90, Girik 4 Nov). shoulder_table: the shoulder angle at table height, 180 (Girik, 4 Nov); the pick starts approach (10) degrees above it, at 170. ring_calibrate.py --table-shoulder saves a different one with the fit. grip_hold 20 (found by hand, 4 Nov). command_s 0.01 (pick_once.py --measure-latency, 4 Nov: 3.5 ms mean, 4.7 ms slowest). stop_at null: the shoulder is never sent more than 3 degrees past shoulder_table. A point more than max_off_ring_cm from the ring is refused. marker_name: the SAM prompt for the claw-tip marker; on a real iVCam frame (4 Nov) 'gripper marker', 'yellow square', 'yellow sticker' and 'yellow foam' found nothing, and 'small yellow rectangle' found the marker and the control board's yellow pin sockets, so only a box on the sheet counts. camera_frames: how many frames each photo grab reads, keeping the last: the first frames are blown out on this camera (needs.md A9); --camera-frames overrides it. camera_name: the Windows webcam ffmpeg reads ('e2eSoft iVCam' or 'Camo'); the MIMIC_CAMERA environment variable and --camera-name override it. source: where the fit came from, 'camera' (ring_calibrate.py) or 'manual' (ring_fit_manual.py, ruler-measured points).
